district.name: Flatiron and Madison Square
district.area_description: A bounded pedestrian-scale Manhattan district centered on the Flatiron Building

decision.selected_package: NYC Open Data BUILDING and SIDEWALK with Orimera-authored ground, road completion, materials, and fantasy content
decision.reason: The governing NYC Open Data law makes public datasets available without license requirements or use restrictions, subject to source, version, and modification identification. The measured district sample provides complete roof-height coverage for 400 building footprints and 32 detailed sidewalk polygons.
decision.fallback_reason: Technically viable, but both themes are ODbL databases with attribution and share-alike analysis for derivative databases, and public release objects have a short retention window. This adds obligations without improving the already measured first slice.
